import { MeshStandardNodeMaterial, MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, float } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, DirectionalLight, Color } = ctx.THREE;

  const group = new Group();

  // 1. PALETTE DEFINITIONS (Verbatim from spec)
  const colors = {
    ink: new Color('#16161d'),
    paper: new Color('#e8ecf2'),
    accent: new Color('#ff2a38'),
    surface: new Color('#0b0b10')
  };

  // 2. STAGE BACKDROP (Prevents FLAT_VOID defect)
  // Large plane at z = -2.5 carrying vertical color gradient from surface to ink
  const bgGeometry = new PlaneGeometry(16, 12);
  const bgMaterial = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ depthWrite: false });
  
  const bgUv = uv();
  const bgGradient = mix(
    vec3(colors.surface.r, colors.surface.g, colors.surface.b),
    vec3(colors.ink.r, colors.ink.g, colors.ink.b),
    bgUv.y
  );
  bgMaterial.colorNode = bgGradient;

  const bgMesh = new Mesh(bgGeometry, bgMaterial);
  bgMesh.position.z = -2.5;
  group.add(bgMesh);

  // 3. MAIN CARD PORTRAIT (Ratio matches 512x320 source rect = 1.6)
  const width = 2.4;
  const height = 1.5;
  const cardGeometry = new PlaneGeometry(width, height, 32, 32);

  const cardMaterial = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    roughness: 0.45,
    metalness: 0.55,
    transparent: true,
  });

  // Load the brushed metal map if available
  let loadedTexture = null;
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      loadedTexture = tex;
      tex.wrapS = 1000;
      tex.wrapT = 1000;
      cardMaterial.roughnessMap = tex;
      cardMaterial.needsUpdate = true;
    });
  }

  // TSL graphics: gradient + top edge rim lighting + crimson engine line accent
  const cardUv = uv();
  const baseGradient = mix(
    vec3(colors.surface.r, colors.surface.g, colors.surface.b),
    vec3(colors.ink.r, colors.ink.g, colors.ink.b),
    cardUv.y
  );

  // Top highlight border (y > 0.98)
  const topRim = cardUv.y.sub(0.985).step(0.0);

  // Precision signal line near bottom (centered at y = 0.08)
  const distToLine = cardUv.y.sub(0.08).abs();
  const redBar = float(1.0).sub(distToLine.step(0.006));

  // Layer the card styling elegantly
  const withRim = mix(baseGradient, vec3(colors.paper.r, colors.paper.g, colors.paper.b), topRim.mul(0.2));
  const finalColorNode = mix(withRim, vec3(colors.accent.r, colors.accent.g, colors.accent.b), redBar);

  cardMaterial.colorNode = finalColorNode;

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeometry, cardMaterial);
  cardMesh.castShadow = true;
  cardMesh.receiveShadow = true;
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // 4. LOCAL PRODUCT LIGHTING (Submits to WHITE-SUBJECT KEY CEILING)
  const rimLight = new DirectionalLight(colors.accent, 0.7);
  rimLight.position.set(-3, -2, 1);
  group.add(rimLight);

  const specLight = new DirectionalLight(colors.paper, 0.9);
  specLight.position.set(3, 4, 3);
  group.add(specLight);

  // 5. ENTRANCE TRANSITION (Weighted-settle)
  group.position.y -= 0.3;
  group.scale.set(0.95, 0.95, 0.95);

  const introTl = gsap.timeline({ defaults: { overwrite: 'auto' } });
  introTl.to(group.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 1.0,
    ease: 'power3.out'
  });
  introTl.to(group.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 1.2,
    ease: 'elastic.out(1, 0.8)'
  }, 0);

  // Apply visual primitives (if declared)
  const activePrimitives = [];
  if (config.cinematicPrimitives) {
    for (const prim of config.cinematicPrimitives) {
      if (ctx.primitives[prim.name]) {
        const inst = ctx.primitives[prim.name](group, prim.params);
        if (inst) activePrimitives.push(inst);
      }
    }
  }

  // 6. EXPLICIT CLEANUP INTERFACE
  group.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup() {
      // Terminate animation workflows safely
      if (introTl) introTl.kill();
      
      // Release GPU pipelines and textures
      bgGeometry.dispose();
      bgMaterial.dispose();
      cardGeometry.dispose();
      cardMaterial.dispose();
      if (loadedTexture) {
        loadedTexture.dispose();
      }

      // Dispose primitives
      activePrimitives.forEach(p => {
        if (typeof p.cleanup === 'function') {
          p.cleanup();
        }
      });
    }
  };

  return group;
}
